hold_text: Console connector sign-in (G1) for the trainer VM service. Merging changes nothing at runtime: sign-in is off unless the unit sets CONSOLE_CONNECTOR_AUTH=google, which the post-merge deploy does. Operator decision 2026-11-05 ~09:55Z, verbatim popup option: "Open 443 + Google OAuth (Recommended)", plus U5 (sign-in). The manager lands it.
why: OAuth 2.1 for claude.ai: RFC 9728/8414 discovery, RFC 7591 registration limited to claude.ai and claude.com redirect hosts, authorization code with S256 PKCE, refresh-token rotation, and a 401 Bearer challenge on /mcp. The person signs in with a Google ID token for the dashboard's public client id, and the verified email must equal ALLOWED_EMAIL. There is no client secret anywhere. Tokens are stored as SHA-256 hashes only. If sign-in is on but unconfigured, the server refuses reads (503). Tests: tests/console_connector (22).
